attack_params.checkpoint_selection: per-image maximum output global-direction variance ratio times max(0, 1 - normalized-local output dispersion / input dispersion); native block input/output; select once; earliest native tie; drop at selected block input

checkpoint_score_normalization.denominator: total local population variance / native feature dimension
checkpoint_score_normalization.precision: float64 normalized geometry from float32 features
checkpoint_score_normalization.contraction: max(0, 1 - output total normalized-local population variance / input total normalized-local population variance)

attack_params.checkpoint_tie_break: earliest block in native forward order
attack_params.drop_count_rounding: total ratio rounded to 12 decimals; max(1, round(native token count * ratio))
